columns.name: ad_group_id
columns.comment: The ID of the ad group.

columns.name: label_id
columns.comment: Id of the label. Read only.

columns.name: ad_group_label_ad_group
columns.comment: The ad group to which the label is attached.

columns.name: ad_group_label_label
columns.comment: The label assigned to the ad group.

columns.name: ad_group_label_resource_name
columns.comment: The resource name of the ad group label. Ad group label resource names have the form: `customers/{customer_id}/adGroupLabels/{ad_group_id}~{label_id}`

columns.name: ad_group_name
columns.comment: The name of the ad group. This field is required and should not be empty when creating new ad groups. It must contain fewer than 255 UTF-8 full-width characters. It must not contain any null (code point 0x0), NL line feed (code point 0xA) or carriage return (code point 0xD) characters.

columns.name: label_name
columns.comment: The name of the label. This field is required and should not be empty when creating a new label. The length of this string should be between 1 and 80, inclusive.

columns.name: label_resource_name
columns.comment: Name of the resource. Label resource names have the form: `customers/{customer_id}/labels/{label_id}`
